title: Rolling Sink: Bridging Limited-Horizon Training and Open-Ended Testing in Autoregressive Video Diffusion
tldr_zh: 把超出训练时长后的退化归因于缓存内容与训练时不一致，提出免训练的推理时缓存策略：在固定预算内保留低漂移内容与少量近期上下文，并滑动时间索引、调度语义。
tldr_en: Attributes degradation beyond the training horizon to a mismatch between test-time and training-time cache contents, and proposes a training-free cache policy that, within a fixed budget, restores low-drift content, sliding temporal indices, and evolving semantics while keeping a small recent context.

title: Relax Forcing: Relaxed KV-Memory for Consistent Long Video Generation
tldr_zh: 分析自回归长视频推理中KV记忆的数量与时间位置对运动的影响，提出免训练的记忆结构：汇点帧提供全局稳定，尾部帧保持短期连贯，并按松弛准则挑选与全局锚点对齐、与近期内容不冗余的历史帧。
tldr_en: Studies how the amount and temporal placement of KV memory shape motion in long autoregressive rollouts, and proposes a training-free memory of sink frames for global stability, tail frames for short-term continuity, and history frames chosen by a relaxation criterion that favors alignment with global anchors and penalizes redundancy with recent context.

title: PackForcing: Short Video Training Suffices for Long Video Sampling and Long Context Inference
tldr_zh: 把自回归视频生成的历史KV分为三部分：全分辨率保留的汇点token、经双分支网络大幅压缩并按top-k动态选取的中段token、全分辨率的近期token，并用时间RoPE调整弥合丢弃token留下的位置间隔。
tldr_en: Splits the KV history of autoregressive video generation into full-resolution sink tokens, heavily compressed mid tokens picked by dynamic top-k selection, and full-resolution recent tokens, with a temporal RoPE adjustment that closes the position gaps left by dropped tokens.

title: Attend Locally, Remember Linearly: Linear Attention as Cross-Frame Memory for Autoregressive Video Diffusion
tldr_zh: 把预训练自回归视频扩散模型改为混合注意力：帧内保留softmax注意力，帧间用门控循环线性注意力维护固定大小的状态作为跨帧记忆，且只在去噪完成后更新状态。
tldr_en: Converts a pretrained autoregressive video diffusion model to hybrid attention, keeping softmax attention within each frame and replacing cross-frame attention with a gated recurrent linear branch whose fixed-size state acts as memory and is updated only after a frame is fully denoised.

title: SlotMemory: Object-Centric KV Memory for Streaming Long-Video Generation
tldr_zh: 流式视频扩散的以物体为中心的KV记忆，把键值空间分解为可复用的语义槽位，以槽位为地址存取高保真KV token，使实体在出画或提示切换后仍保持一致。
tldr_en: An object-centric KV memory for streaming video diffusion that decomposes the key-value space into reusable semantic slots and uses them as addresses to store and retrieve high-fidelity KV tokens, so entities stay consistent after leaving the frame or across prompt changes.

title: MASS: Multiplayer World Models with Authoritative Shared State
tldr_zh: 针对多人世界模型把世界状态与视角相关的视觉latent纠缠在一起的问题，由学习的逻辑引擎根据联合动作推进全局权威的类型化状态，作为唯一的循环记忆与同步基准，再由渲染引擎为任意相机生成视图。
tldr_en: Separates world dynamics from rendering in multiplayer world models: a learned logic engine advances a global, authoritative typed state from joint actions as the only recurrent memory and synchronization reference, and a learned rendering engine draws views for any requested camera.

title: Programmable World Model
tldr_zh: 将世界状态演化与画面生成解耦：智能体把自然语言指令转成规定实体状态和转移规则的程序，由轻量引擎维护包括画外实体在内的显式持久世界状态，再把状态表示为带属性的三维有向包围盒，连同相机轨迹编译为像素对齐的时空条件，交给预训练视频模型渲染；另构建CombatStateBench。
tldr_en: Decouples world-state evolution from rendering: an agent turns language instructions into programs that define entity states and transition rules, a lightweight engine maintains an explicit persistent world state that includes off-screen entities, and state-augmented 3D oriented bounding boxes are compiled into conditioning for a video model; the paper also introduces CombatStateBench.

title: Pyramidal Flow Matching for Efficient Video Generative Modeling
tldr_zh: 把去噪轨迹重解释为多级金字塔阶段、只在最后一级使用全分辨率，并在自回归视频生成中用时间金字塔以低分辨率压缩历史。
tldr_en: Recasts the denoising trajectory as pyramid stages with only the last at full resolution, and compresses the full-resolution history into lower-resolution latents through a temporal pyramid for autoregressive video generation.

title: EnerVerse: Envisioning Embodied Future Space for Robotics Manipulation
tldr_zh: 分块自回归视频扩散按指令预测多视角的未来具身空间，以稀疏上下文记忆支撑长程推理，再由策略头把预测转为动作。
tldr_en: A chunk-wise autoregressive video diffusion model predicts multi-view future embodied spaces from instructions, relies on a sparse context memory for long-horizon reasoning, and turns the predictions into actions through a policy head.

title: StarGen: A Spatiotemporal Autoregression Framework with Video Diffusion Model for Scalable and Controllable Scene Generation
tldr_zh: 用预训练视频扩散模型自回归生成大范围场景，每段以空间相邻图像的三维变换和与上一段时间重叠的图像为条件，保持位姿可控下的长程一致。
tldr_en: Uses a pretrained video diffusion model autoregressively for large-scale scene generation, conditioning each clip on 3D-warped spatially adjacent images and a temporally overlapping frame from the previous clip to stay consistent over long pose-controlled trajectories.

title: EDELINE: Enhancing Memory in Diffusion-based World Models via Linear-Time Sequence Modeling
tldr_zh: 针对扩散世界模型固定上下文窗口限制记忆的问题，把状态空间模型与扩散模型结合，以线性时间序列建模保留更长历史。
tldr_en: Diffusion world models with a fixed context window have limited memory, so it combines a state space model with diffusion to carry longer history at linear cost.

title: MALT Diffusion: Memory-Augmented Latent Transformers for Any-Length Video Generation
tldr_zh: 将长视频切成短片段自回归生成，用循环注意力层把历史片段编码为紧凑的记忆隐向量并持续更新作条件，训练时对记忆向量加噪以抑制长程误差累积。
tldr_en: Generates long videos segment by segment, using recurrent attention layers to fold past segments into a compact memory latent that conditions each new segment, and adds noise to the memory during training to curb error accumulation over long horizons.

title: Toward Stable World Models: Measuring and Addressing World Instability in Generative Environments
tldr_zh: 提出世界稳定性评测，让世界模型执行一串动作后再执行逆动作回到起始视角，比较首尾观测的一致性，并探索若干提升稳定性的策略。
tldr_en: Proposes a world-stability evaluation in which a world model executes an action sequence and then its inverse to return to the starting view, comparing the first and last observations, and explores several strategies for improving stability.

title: Long Context Tuning for Video Generation
tldr_zh: 把预训练单镜头视频扩散模型的全注意力扩展到同一场景的所有镜头，配合交错三维位置编码与异步噪声策略学习镜头间一致性，再微调为因果注意力以借助KV缓存逐镜头自回归生成。
tldr_en: Extends a pretrained single-shot video diffusion model's full attention to every shot in a scene, using interleaved 3D position embeddings and asynchronous noise to learn cross-shot consistency, then fine-tunes it with context-causal attention for shot-by-shot generation over a KV cache.

title: Error Analyses of Auto-Regressive Video Diffusion Models: A Unified Framework
tldr_zh: 建立自回归视频扩散模型的统一误差分析框架，用条件互信息刻画历史遗忘、用逐步误差累积刻画时序退化，并在DMLab与Minecraft中提出大海捞针式的历史检索评测。
tldr_en: A unified theoretical framework for autoregressive video diffusion models that characterizes history forgetting through conditional mutual information and temporal degradation through accumulated per-step error, with a needle-in-a-haystack retrieval protocol in DMLab and Minecraft to measure forgetting.

title: Scene Splatter: Momentum 3D Scene Generation from Single Image with Video Diffusion Model
tldr_zh: 从单张图像迭代生成三维场景，以原始特征构造的含噪样本作为隐空间动量、以一致视频作为像素级动量引导视频扩散，并用增强帧微调全局高斯、渲染新帧更新下一步动量。
tldr_en: Builds a 3D scene from a single image iteratively, guiding video diffusion with latent momentum from noised original features and pixel-level momentum from a consistent video, then refining global Gaussians with the enhanced frames and rendering them to update the momentum for the next step.

title: A Survey of Interactive Generative Video
tldr_zh: 梳理交互式生成视频在游戏、具身智能和自动驾驶中的应用，并把理想系统拆分为生成、控制、记忆、动力学与智能等模块，逐一分析实时生成、长时一致性等挑战。
tldr_en: Surveys interactive generative video in gaming, embodied AI, and autonomous driving, and breaks an ideal system into generation, control, memory, dynamics, and intelligence modules, discussing the open problems of each, such as real-time generation and long-term coherence.

title: Test-Time Training Done Right
tldr_zh: 以极大的数据块在线更新快权重来做测试时训练，提高硬件利用率并扩大非线性记忆状态容量，用于新视角合成、语言建模和自回归视频扩散的长上下文建模。
tldr_en: Performs test-time training by updating fast weights over very large chunks, which raises GPU utilization and scales up the nonlinear state that holds long context, applied to novel view synthesis, language modeling and autoregressive video diffusion.

title: TransDreamerV3: Implanting Transformer In DreamerV3
tldr_zh: 在DreamerV3世界模型中加入Transformer编码器，以增强基于模型的强化学习智能体的记忆与决策能力，在Atari与Crafter上评测。
tldr_en: Adds a transformer encoder to the DreamerV3 world model to strengthen memory and decision-making in model-based RL, evaluated on Atari and Crafter.

title: Voyaging into Perpetual Dynamic Scenes from a Single View
tldr_zh: 把单视角永续动态场景生成视为外绘：将视频按估计深度映射为动态点云，从新视角渲染残缺视频后借光线信息外绘，再用外绘结果更新点云供后续视角使用。
tldr_en: Recasts single-view perpetual dynamic scene generation as outpainting: the video is lifted to a dynamic point cloud, partial renders from new viewpoints are completed using per-ray cues, and the outpainted video is written back into the point cloud for later views.

title: Scenepainter: Semantically Consistent Perpetual 3D Scene Generation with Concept Relation Alignment
tldr_zh: 沿相机轨迹逐步外绘生成三维视图序列，用随新视图更新的多层场景概念图定制外绘模型，并在生成中做测试时训练，抑制长程语义漂移。
tldr_en: Generates perpetual 3D view sequences by outpainting along a camera trajectory, customizing the outpainter with a hierarchical scene concept graph refined as new views arrive and with test-time training to curb semantic drift.

title: World Consistency Score: A Unified Metric for Video Generation Quality
tldr_zh: 提出生成视频的世界一致性指标，组合物体恒存、关系稳定、因果合规与闪烁惩罚四个子项，并用人类偏好数据学习权重。
tldr_en: Proposes a world-consistency metric for generated videos that combines object permanence, relation stability, causal compliance and a flicker penalty, with weights learned from human preference data.

title: CausNVS: Autoregressive Multi-view Diffusion for Flexible 3D Novel View Synthesis
tldr_zh: 以因果掩码和逐帧噪声训练自回归多视图扩散模型，用相对位姿编码控制相机，推理时保留位姿空间中最近视角的KV缓存作为空间记忆来抑制漂移。
tldr_en: An autoregressive multi-view diffusion model trained with causal masking and per-frame noise and steered by relative pose encodings, which at inference keeps the KV cache of the nearest views in pose space as spatial memory to curb drift.

title: SANA-Video: Efficient Video Generation with Block Linear Diffusion Transformer
tldr_zh: 以线性注意力为核心的块自回归视频扩散模型，利用线性注意力的累积性质把全部历史压缩为恒定大小的状态以替代KV cache，在固定显存下为分钟级长视频生成提供全局上下文。
tldr_en: A block-autoregressive linear-attention diffusion transformer that exploits the cumulative form of linear attention to compress all history into a constant-size state in place of a KV cache, giving minute-long video generation global context at fixed memory cost.

title: Video Replanning via Latent Embedding Refinement and Rejection-Based Sampling
tldr_zh: 视频规划框架在操作失败后从交互视频中优化一个刻画隐藏物理属性的潜嵌入，并用拒绝采样剔除与以往失败相矛盾的候选计划，使重规划利用此前试错揭示的信息。
tldr_en: A video-planning framework that, after a failed attempt, optimizes a latent embedding capturing hidden physical properties from interaction videos and rejects candidate plans inconsistent with earlier failures, so replanning builds on what trial and error revealed.

title: From Masks to Worlds: A Hitchhiker's Guide to World Models
tldr_zh: 不求罗列所有世界模型，而是沿一条主线梳理：从统一多模态表示的掩码模型，到共享单一范式的统一架构，再到闭合动作—感知回路的交互式生成模型，最后到让世界长期保持一致的记忆增强系统。
tldr_en: A guide rather than a catalog, following one path from masked models that unified representation learning across modalities, through unified architectures and interactive generative models that close the action-perception loop, to memory-augmented systems that keep worlds consistent over time.

title: Autoscape: Geometry-Consistent Long-Horizon Scene Generation
tldr_zh: 迭代生成稀疏的RGB-D关键帧作为外观与几何锚点，每个新关键帧以此前关键帧点云的渲染为条件并用扭曲一致引导采样，再由视频扩散模型在关键帧间插帧，生成长时程几何一致的驾驶视频。
tldr_en: Iteratively generates sparse RGB-D keyframes as appearance and geometry anchors, conditioning each new one on rendered point clouds from earlier keyframes and steering sampling with warp-consistent guidance, then interpolates between keyframes with a video diffusion model to produce long, geometrically consistent driving videos.

title: Generative View Stitching
tldr_zh: 对预设相机轨迹的整段视频并行采样，把扩散拼接推广到用Diffusion Forcing训练的现成视频模型，并以同时依赖过去与未来的Omni Guidance和闭环机制保持长程一致。
tldr_en: Samples the entire video for a predefined camera trajectory in parallel, extending diffusion stitching to off-the-shelf Diffusion Forcing video models, with Omni Guidance conditioning on both past and future and a loop-closing mechanism for long-range coherence.

title: A Step Toward World Models: A Survey on Robotic Manipulation
tldr_zh: 不限于自称世界模型的工作，从机器人操作中具备世界模型核心能力的方法出发，分析其在感知、预测与控制中的作用，归纳完整世界模型应有的组件、能力与功能。
tldr_en: Rather than fixing a definition, reviews robotic manipulation methods that show core world-model capabilities, whether or not they carry the label, examining their roles in perception, prediction, and control and distilling the components and functions a full world model should have.

title: MotionStream: Real-Time Video Generation with Interactive Motion Controls
tldr_zh: 把运动控制视频模型蒸馏成因果流式生成器，用滑窗因果注意力加注意力汇与KV滚动，在固定上下文下实时生成任意长视频。
tldr_en: Distills a motion-controlled video model into a causal streaming generator that uses sliding-window attention with attention sinks and KV-cache rolling, producing arbitrarily long videos in real time with a fixed context.

title: Learning to Focus: Prioritizing Informative Histories with Structured Attention Mechanisms in Partially Observable Reinforcement Learning
authors: Daniel De Dios Allegue et al.
tldr_zh: 针对部分可观测强化学习中 Transformer 世界模型在历史上均匀分配注意力的问题，在动力学头加入按头的记忆长度先验与对历史状态-动作对的高斯加权先验。
tldr_en: Adds structured priors to the dynamics-head attention of a Transformer world model under partial observability, using per-head memory-length windows and learned Gaussian weightings over past state-action pairs to focus on the transitions that matter.

title: Infinity-RoPE: Action-Controllable Infinite Video Generation Emerges From Autoregressive Self-Rollout
tldr_zh: 为自回归视频扩散设计免训练推理框架：以块相对 RoPE 突破位置编码的时长上限，用 KV Flush 在提示切换时只保留全局 sink 帧与最后一帧以即时响应新动作，用 RoPE Cut 在单次推演中实现镜头切换。
tldr_en: A training-free inference framework for autoregressive video diffusion that uses block-relative RoPE to run past the positional horizon, flushes the KV cache down to a global sink and the last frame so new action prompts take effect immediately, and cuts RoPE coordinates to create scene transitions in one rollout.

title: AdaPower: Specializing World Foundation Models for Predictive Manipulation
tldr_zh: 将通用世界基础模型改造为操作专用世界模型，用时空测试时训练在推理时自适应、用记忆持久模块保持长程一致，并嵌入模型预测控制为预训练VLA提供前瞻。
tldr_en: Turns a general world foundation model into a specialist manipulation world model, adapting it at inference with spatio-temporal test-time training and keeping long rollouts consistent with a memory persistence module, then uses it inside model predictive control to steer pretrained VLAs.

title: Astra: General Interactive World Model with Autoregressive Denoising
tldr_zh: 自回归去噪的通用交互世界模型，以因果注意力聚合历史观测，对历史记忆加噪以免过度依赖过去帧、兼顾动作响应与时间连贯，并用动作适配器和动作专家混合支持相机运动、机器人动作等多种控制。
tldr_en: A general interactive world model built on autoregressive denoising that aggregates past observations with causal attention, adds noise to its history memory so it does not over-rely on past frames, and handles camera motion, robot actions and other controls through an action adapter and a mixture of action experts.

title: StoryMem: Multi-shot Long Video Storytelling with Memory
tldr_zh: 把长篇故事视频改写为以显式视觉记忆为条件的逐镜头生成，维护由历史镜头关键帧组成、动态更新的紧凑记忆库，经潜变量拼接与负向RoPE偏移注入单镜头视频扩散模型，并以语义关键帧选择和美学过滤决定记忆内容。
tldr_en: Recasts long-form video storytelling as shot-by-shot generation conditioned on explicit visual memory: a compact, dynamically updated bank of keyframes from earlier shots is injected into a single-shot video diffusion model through latent concatenation and negative RoPE shifts, with semantic keyframe selection and aesthetic filtering deciding what stays in memory.

title: WorldWarp: Propagating 3D Geometry with Asynchronous Video Diffusion
tldr_zh: 在线维护由三维高斯构建的几何缓存，把历史内容扭曲到新视角作为结构支架，再用时空变化噪声调度的扩散模型补全空洞并修正扭曲区域，逐步更新缓存以保持长程几何一致。
tldr_en: Keeps an online 3D Gaussian Splatting cache that warps past content into each new view as a structural scaffold, then a diffusion model with a spatio-temporally varying noise schedule fills holes and refines warped regions, updating the cache at every step to stay geometrically consistent over long videos.

title: Yume-1.5: A Text-Controlled Interactive World Generation Model
tldr_zh: 由单张图像或文本生成可用键盘探索的交互世界，以结合线性注意力的统一上下文压缩应对不断增长的历史上下文，用双向注意力蒸馏实现实时流式生成，并支持文本控制的世界事件。
tldr_en: Generates keyboard-explorable interactive worlds from a single image or text prompt, curbing the ever-growing history with unified context compression and linear attention, distilling bidirectional attention for real-time streaming, and letting text prompts trigger world events.

title: Mamba World Model for RL: Enhancing Long-term Memory in Model-based Reinforcement Learning
tldr_zh: 针对 RNN 长期记忆差、Transformer 的 KV 缓存线性增长的问题，以 Mamba 状态空间模型构建强化学习世界模型并加入熵项，以常数推理复杂度支持更长历史。
tldr_en: Builds a model-based RL world model on Mamba, adding an entropy term for sample efficiency, so it can carry long histories at constant inference cost instead of relying on a forgetful RNN or an ever-growing Transformer KV cache.

title: A Mechanistic View on Video Generation as World Models: State and Dynamics
tldr_zh: 以状态构建与动力学建模两条主线梳理视频生成世界模型：状态构建分为隐式的上下文管理与显式的隐空间压缩，动力学建模分为知识融入与架构重构，并把数据驱动的记忆列为增强持久性的方向。
tldr_en: Frames video-generation world models around state construction, split into implicit context management and explicit latent compression, and dynamics modeling, covering knowledge integration and architectural reformulation, and points to data-driven memory as a way to improve persistence.

title: PerpetualWonder: Long-Horizon Action-Conditioned 4D Scene Generation
tldr_zh: 从单张图像出发的动作条件4D场景生成模拟器，将物理粒子与高斯基元双向绑定为统一表示，使生成式修正能同时更新外观和物理状态，并带入后续多轮交互。
tldr_en: A hybrid generative simulator that turns a single image into an action-conditioned 4D scene, binding physics particles and Gaussian primitives into one representation so generative refinements update both appearance and physical state and carry over into later interactions.

title: Flow caching for autoregressive video generation
tldr_zh: 面向自回归视频生成的缓存加速框架，为每个视频块设独立的逐步重算策略，并按重要性与冗余度联合压缩KV缓存，使显存占用保持固定上界。
tldr_en: A caching framework for autoregressive video generation that gives each chunk its own recomputation schedule across denoising steps and compresses the KV cache by jointly scoring importance and redundancy to stay within a fixed memory bound.

title: PACT-WAM: Predicting Actions and Visual Foresight with Compact Temporal Encoding for Robot Manipulation
tldr_zh: 联合生成动作轨迹与对应视觉预测的世界动作模型，用分层历史编码为较早观测分配粗粒度、为近期观测分配细粒度表示，以较少token保留较长观测历史。
tldr_en: A world action model that jointly generates an action chunk and the matching visual forecast, with hierarchical history encoding that gives earlier observations coarse tokens and recent ones finer tokens to keep a longer history at lower cost.

title: Next Embedding Prediction Makes World Models Stronger
tldr_zh: 无解码器的基于模型强化学习智能体，用时序Transformer从潜状态序列预测下一步编码器嵌入，在表示空间直接优化时序预测对齐，以应对部分可观测环境中的长程依赖。
tldr_en: A decoder-free model-based RL agent whose temporal transformer predicts the next encoder embedding from the sequence of latent states, directly optimizing temporal predictive alignment in representation space to handle long-range dependencies under partial observability.

title: Helios: Real Real-Time Long Video Generation Model
tldr_zh: 14B自回归扩散长视频模型，大幅压缩历史与噪声上下文并减少采样步数以实现实时生成，训练中显式模拟漂移以抑制长视频漂移与重复运动。
tldr_en: A 14B autoregressive diffusion model for real-time minute-scale video that heavily compresses the historical and noisy context and cuts sampling steps, and explicitly simulates drift during training to curb drifting and repetitive motion.

title: ShotStream: Streaming Multi-Shot Video Generation for Interactive Storytelling
tldr_zh: 把多镜头视频生成改写为以历史镜头为条件的逐镜头因果生成，用全局缓存保留历史镜头的条件帧、局部缓存保留当前镜头已生成帧，并以两阶段自强制蒸馏缓解误差累积。
tldr_en: Recasts multi-shot video generation as causal next-shot generation conditioned on earlier shots, keeping their conditioning frames in a global cache and the current shot's frames in a local cache, and uses two-stage self-forcing distillation to curb error accumulation.

title: Video Generation Models as World Models: Efficient Paradigms, Architectures and Algorithms
tldr_zh: 以效率为主线梳理视频生成世界模型，按高效建模范式、高效网络架构和高效推理算法分类，并讨论效率对自动驾驶、具身智能和游戏模拟等交互应用的作用。
tldr_en: Reviews video-generation world models through the lens of efficiency, sorting work into efficient modeling paradigms, network architectures, and inference algorithms, and relating them to interactive uses in driving, embodied AI, and game simulation.

title: Beyond Single-Speed Reasoning: Coordinating Fast and Slow Dynamics for Efficient World Modeling
tldr_zh: 把循环状态空间世界模型拆成快慢双分支：快分支用残差预测短期转移，慢分支用GRU循环通路建模长程依赖，并蒸馏软目标指导快分支。
tldr_en: Splits a recurrent state-space world model into fast and slow branches: the fast branch predicts short-horizon transitions residually, while the slow branch models long-range dependencies through a GRU pathway and distills soft targets into the fast one.

title: LivingWorld: Interactive 4D World Generation with Environmental Dynamics
tldr_zh: 从单张图像出发随用户相机移动逐步外扩场景，把每步新增的场景流累积进全局哈希运动场并做几何感知对齐，使云、水、烟等环境动态在整个扩展场景中保持连贯。
tldr_en: Starting from a single image, expands the scene as the user moves the camera, accumulating each step's scene flow into a global hash-based motion field with geometry-aware alignment so that environmental dynamics such as clouds, water and smoke stay coherent across the whole expanded scene.

title: Long-Horizon Streaming Video Generation via Hybrid Attention with Decoupled Distillation
tldr_zh: 在流式视频生成的滑动窗口注意力之外加入轻量线性时间注意力，用紧凑的键值状态逐步吸收移出窗口的 token 以保留远距离历史，窗口内用块稀疏注意力减少计算，并配合解耦蒸馏训练。
tldr_en: Adds lightweight linear temporal attention alongside the sliding-window attention of a streaming video generator, folding evicted tokens into a compact key-value state to keep distant history, uses block-sparse attention inside the window, and trains it with decoupled distillation.

title: HY-World 2.0: A Multi-Modal World Model for Reconstructing, Generating, and Simulating 3D Worlds
tldr_zh: 多模态三维世界生成框架，经全景生成、轨迹规划、关键帧视角扩展与重建得到可漫游的3DGS场景，其中基于关键帧的视角生成模型带有一致性记忆。
tldr_en: A multi-modal 3D world framework that turns text or images into navigable 3DGS scenes through panorama generation, trajectory planning, keyframe-based view expansion and reconstruction, with the view generator upgraded to keep a consistent memory.

title: DexWorldModel: Causal Latent World Modeling towards Automated Learning of Embodied Tasks
tldr_zh: 以 DINOv3 特征为生成目标的因果隐空间世界动作模型，用双状态测试时训练记忆让长程任务的存储占用保持恒定，并以推测式异步推理把部分去噪隐藏在动作执行期间。
tldr_en: A causal latent world action model that predicts DINOv3 features rather than pixels, uses a dual-state test-time-training memory to keep a constant footprint over long-horizon tasks, and hides part of the denoising behind physical execution through speculative asynchronous inference.

title: Human Cognition in Machines: A Unified Perspective of World Models
tldr_zh: 按所革新的认知功能区分世界模型工作，提出涵盖记忆、感知、语言、推理、想象、动机与元认知的统一框架，并用于视频、具身以及新提出的面向科学发现的认识型世界模型，指出研究空白。
tldr_en: Classifies world-model work by the cognitive functions it advances, proposing a unified framework that covers memory, perception, language, reasoning, imagination, motivation, and metacognition, and applies it to video, embodied, and newly defined epistemic world models to locate research gaps.

title: Active World-Model with 4D-informed Retrieval for Exploration and Awareness
tldr_zh: 把感知决策当作部分可观测问题，以查询的相机感知动作为条件，从已采集的观测中做四维信息检索，结合动作条件几何支撑与生成式补全来预测相应观测。
tldr_en: Frames sensing decisions as a partially observable problem and predicts the observation for a queried camera action by retrieving previously collected evidence with 4D cues, combining action-conditioned geometric support with generative completion.

title: Sparse Forcing: Native Trainable Sparse Attention for Real-time Autoregressive Diffusion Video Generation
tldr_zh: 观察到自回归视频扩散中注意力集中于少量持久的显著块，提出可训练的原生稀疏注意力，学习压缩、保留和更新这些持久块作为KV缓存记忆，窗口内只计算动态选出的局部邻域。
tldr_en: Observing that attention in autoregressive video diffusion concentrates on a persistent set of salient blocks, it learns a native sparse attention that compresses, keeps and updates those blocks as KV-cache memory, while restricting in-window computation to a dynamically chosen local neighborhood.

title: dWorldEval: Scalable Robotic Policy Evaluation via Discrete Diffusion World Model
tldr_zh: 把视觉、语言和机器人动作映射到统一token空间，用离散扩散世界模型作策略评测代理，以稀疏关键帧记忆保持时空一致，并联合预测进度token自动判定任务成功。
tldr_en: A discrete diffusion world model that maps vision, language and robot actions into one token space as a proxy for policy evaluation, using a sparse keyframe memory for spatiotemporal consistency and a jointly predicted progress token to decide task success.

title: Uncertainty-Aware Stochastic Hybrid World Models with Neural Map Memory for Autonomous Navigation in Partially Observable Grid Environments
tldr_zh: 在部分可观的网格导航中，将随机隐空间动力学世界模型与带不确定性的神经地图记忆结合，用地图中的空间信息与不确定性估计指导探索与决策。
tldr_en: For navigation in partially observable grid worlds, it combines a stochastic latent-dynamics world model with an uncertainty-aware neural map memory whose spatial contents and uncertainty estimates guide exploration and decisions.

title: Latent State Design for World Models under Sufficiency Constraints
tldr_zh: 把世界模型研究看作满足充分性约束的隐状态设计，按隐状态的用途而非架构，将方法分为预测嵌入、循环信念状态、物体与因果结构、潜动作接口、规划接口和记忆载体，并从表示、规划、记忆、不确定性等维度对比。
tldr_en: Treats world-model research as designing latent states under sufficiency constraints, grouping methods by what the state is for (predictive embedding, recurrent belief, object or causal structure, latent action interface, planning interface, memory substrate) rather than by architecture, and compares them on axes including planning, memory, and uncertainty.

title: HaM-World: Soft-Hamiltonian World Models with Selective Memory for Planning
tldr_zh: 以Mamba选择性状态空间记忆汇总过去的观测与动作，作为隐空间转移的条件，并将隐状态分为服从软哈密顿动力学的正则子空间与上下文子空间，用于想象推演与规划。
tldr_en: Summarizes past observations and actions with a Mamba selective state-space memory that conditions the latent transition, and splits the latent state into a canonical subspace following soft-Hamiltonian dynamics and a context subspace, for imagined rollouts and planning.

title: Forcing-KV: Hybrid KV Cache Compression for Efficient Autoregressive Video Diffusion Models
tldr_zh: 发现自回归视频扩散模型的注意力头分为静态头与动态头，对前者做结构化静态剪枝、对后者按片段相似度动态剪枝，以压缩历史帧的KV缓存。
tldr_en: Splits attention heads in autoregressive video diffusion into static and dynamic types, then compresses the history KV cache with structured static pruning for the former and segment-similarity-based dynamic pruning for the latter.

title: Echo-Forcing: A Scene Memory Framework for Interactive Long Video Generation
tldr_zh: 免训练的交互式长视频场景记忆框架，在相对RoPE下把KV缓存拆成稳定锚点、压缩历史与近期窗口，将历史场景压成空间结构化的KV以便回忆，并按新旧场景差异自适应遗忘冲突token。
tldr_en: A training-free scene memory for interactive long video generation that splits the KV cache into stable anchors, compressed history and a recent window under relative RoPE, compresses past scenes into spatially structured KV for later recall, and forgets tokens that conflict with the new scene.

title: PanoWorld: A Generative Spatial World Model for Consistent Whole-House Panorama Synthesis
tldr_zh: 沿导航节点自回归生成全屋360度全景，以户型图导出的三维外壳作全局几何代理，用动态3DGS缓存作可渲染的空间记忆，并按房间拓扑渐进融合局部更新。
tldr_en: Generates a whole-house tour as autoregressive 360-degree panoramas along navigation nodes, using a floorplan-derived 3D shell as the global geometry proxy and a dynamic 3D Gaussian cache as renderable spatial memory, updated progressively by room topology.

title: LongLive-2.0: An NVFP4 Parallel Infrastructure for Long Video Generation
tldr_zh: 基于NVFP4的长视频生成训练与推理基础设施，用序列并行的自回归teacher forcing训练直接把扩散模型调成多镜头交互式自回归模型，推理时把KV缓存量化为NVFP4以节省显存。
tldr_en: An NVFP4 training and inference stack for long video generation that tunes a diffusion model directly into a multi-shot interactive autoregressive generator via sequence-parallel teacher forcing, and stores the KV cache in NVFP4 at inference to save memory.

title: Quantized Keys Steal Attention: Bias Correction for KV-Cache Compression in Video Diffusion
tldr_zh: 指出KV缓存低比特量化的噪声会因softmax指数的凸性抬高历史键的注意力权重，并由量化步长和查询范数在线推导逐分数的偏置校正。
tldr_en: Shows that low-bit KV-cache quantization noise inflates attention to cached keys through the convexity of softmax's exponential, and removes this bias on the fly with a per-score correction derived from the quantization step sizes and the query norm.

title: DriveWAM: Video Generative Priors Enable Scalable World-Action Modeling for Autonomous Driving
tldr_zh: 把预训练视频扩散Transformer改造成自回归的视频-动作驾驶策略，并在推理时按相关性与冗余度筛选KV缓存，维持有界的视频与动作记忆池。
tldr_en: Adapts a pretrained video diffusion transformer into an autoregressive video-action driving policy, keeping long rollouts bounded by selecting KV-cache entries by relevance and redundancy into separate video and action memory pools.

title: Future Forcing: Future-aware Training-free KV Cache Policy for Autoregressive Video Generation
tldr_zh: 利用RoPE前查询分布在生成过程中近似平稳的性质，由历史统计构造未来查询的代理，据此为KV缓存中的token打分并合并冗余token，无需训练。
tldr_en: A training-free KV-cache policy that exploits the near-stationary pre-RoPE query distribution to build a proxy for future queries from history, scoring cached tokens against it and merging redundant pairs.

title: World Models: A Comprehensive Survey of Architectures, Methodologies, Reasoning Paradigms, and Applications
tldr_zh: 从架构、方法族、推理策略和应用领域多个维度组织世界模型，覆盖状态空间、Transformer、扩散、物理信息与语言增强等方法，追溯从 PlaNet、Dreamer 到 Sora、Genie 的发展脉络，并回顾评测协议与基准。
tldr_en: A multi-axis taxonomy of world models spanning architecture, method family (state-space, transformer, diffusion, physics-informed, language-augmented), reasoning strategy, and application domain, tracing the line from PlaNet and Dreamer to Sora and Genie and reviewing evaluation protocols and benchmarks.

title: Towards Interactive Video World Modeling: Frontiers, Challenges, Benchmarks, and Future Trends
tldr_zh: 从应用场景、世界状态演化和场景模态梳理交互式世界建模，重点讨论动作条件可控性、长时交互与记忆、实时响应等技术挑战，并对比开放世界探索、游戏引擎、自动驾驶和机器人领域的基准与指标。
tldr_en: Reviews interactive world modeling by application, state evolution, and scene modality, focuses on action-conditioned control, long-horizon interaction and memory, and real-time responsiveness, and compares benchmarks and metrics across open-world exploration, game engines, driving, and robotics.

title: Echo-Infinity: Learning Evolving Memory for Real-Time Infinite Video Generation
tldr_zh: 用可学习的记忆查询在帧移出局部窗口时经注意力与门控更新，把任意长的历史压缩为恒定开销的演化记忆，并统一相对RoPE方案以消除位置外推差距。
tldr_en: Learnable memory queries are updated by attention and gating whenever frames leave the local window, compressing history of any length into an evolving memory at constant cost, with a unified relative RoPE scheme that closes the position extrapolation gap.

title: MAD: Mapping-Aware World Models for Agile Quadrotor Flight
tldr_zh: 面向四旋翼飞行的Dreamer式世界模型，让循环隐状态重建以机体为中心的占据与可见性栅格地图，迫使其记住已观测区域与局部几何。
tldr_en: A Dreamer-style world model for quadrotor flight whose recurrent latent is trained to reconstruct robot-centric occupancy and visibility grids, forcing it to remember observed regions and local geometry.

title: FlowMo-WM: A World Model with Object Momentum and Hidden Ambient Drift
tldr_zh: 动作条件潜空间世界模型，把图像-动作历史分解为概括物体运动的短历史潜状态和概括水流、风等缓变隐藏扰动的长历史上下文，并用零上下文残差转移分离动作驱动的基础动力学与漂移效应。
tldr_en: An action-conditioned latent world model that factorizes image-action history into a short-history state for object motion and a long-history context for slowly varying hidden drift such as currents or wind, with a zero-context residual transition separating action-driven dynamics from drift effects.

title: Memento: Reconstruct to Remember for Consistent Long Video Generation
tldr_zh: 多镜头长视频生成中，把“记忆库应能仅凭自身重建主体”作为监督，联合训练逐镜头自回归生成与基于历史记忆的主体重建，并用双查询机制分别检索身份相关记忆和用于衔接的近期关键帧。
tldr_en: For multi-shot long video generation, trains next-shot generation jointly with reconstructing recurring subjects from the memory bank alone, using a dual-query mechanism that retrieves identity-relevant memory separately from short-context keyframes for continuity.

title: Kairos: A Regret-Aware Native World-Action Model Stack for Physical AI
authors: Kairos Team Fei Wang et al.
tldr_zh: 面向物理AI的世界动作模型，用跨具身数据课程学习控制相关信息，以局部滑窗、中程扩张滑窗和全局门控线性注意力三条时间通路维持多时间尺度状态，并在部署时兼顾延迟与显存。
tldr_en: A world action model stack for physical AI that learns control-relevant information through a cross-embodiment data curriculum, maintains multi-timescale state with local sliding-window, dilated mid-range and global gated linear attention pathways, and co-designs deployment for latency and memory footprint.

title: World Action Models: A Survey
tldr_zh: 先厘清世界动作模型与视频生成模型、VLA 策略等相邻概念的边界，再从需要生成什么（渲染的未来、隐空间未来或不生成视频）以及预测载体、骨干、动作耦合、部署方式两个视角组织方法，并讨论持久性等性质。
tldr_en: Draws the line between world action models and neighboring categories such as video generators and VLA policies, then organizes methods by what they must generate (rendered futures, latent futures, or no video at all) and by predictive substrate, backbone, action coupling, and deployment, with discussion of persistence and other properties.

title: Perceptual 3D Simulation With Physical World Modeling
tldr_zh: 在部分观测与不完整三维变换信号下模拟场景未来的感知式物理仿真器，由概率式世界模型、提供部分三维变换条件的几何模块和随时间融合预测的持久场景记忆组成，用于新视角合成、物体操作与动态场景预测。
tldr_en: A perceptual physical simulator that predicts future scene states from partial observations and incomplete 3D transform signals, combining a probabilistic world model, a geometric conditioning module and a persistent scene memory that integrates predictions over time, applied to novel view synthesis, object manipulation and dynamic scene prediction.

title: J-LAW: Joint Localization and Action-Conditioned World Modeling via Coupled Latent Factor Graphs
tldr_zh: 把度量位姿、预测性潜状态和持久潜在路标统一到一个耦合因子图中，用最大后验优化约束图像潜状态与位姿或运动测量的一致性，使动作条件世界模型在长时推演和部分观测下保持一致。
tldr_en: Unifies metric poses, predictive latent states and persistent latent landmarks in one coupled factor graph, using MAP optimization to keep image latents consistent with pose or motion measurements so an action-conditioned world model stays consistent over long rollouts and under partial observation.

title: InfiniVerse: Occupancy Guided Unbounded Scene Generation for Autonomous Driving
tldr_zh: 从单帧多视角图像重建三维占据，沿任意轨迹自回归扩展占据并用视频扩散模型渲染为驾驶视频，再把生成视频回投以完善占据，实现二维与三维对齐的无界场景生成。
tldr_en: Reconstructs 3D occupancy from a single multi-view frame, extends it autoregressively along arbitrary trajectories, renders it into driving video with a video diffusion model, and reprojects the generated video to refine the occupancy, yielding 2D-3D-aligned unbounded scene generation.

title: SPREAD: Scalable Pre-Trained World Model for Adaptive Dynamics Model
tldr_zh: 冻结预训练世界模型，只在线更新一组LoRA适配器来持续学习环境变化，不依赖回放缓冲区也能抑制遗忘。
tldr_en: Freezes a pretrained world model and updates only a set of LoRA adapters online, letting it keep learning environment changes continually without a replay buffer.

title: GigaWorld-1: A Roadmap to Build World Models for Robot Policy Evaluation
tldr_zh: 用真实遥操作数据与配对策略回放构建WMBench，系统比较视频世界模型的模型族、动作编码、记忆设计和后训练对策略评估可靠性的影响，并据此构建面向策略评估的世界模型GigaWorld-1。
tldr_en: Builds WMBench from real-robot teleoperation data and paired policy rollouts to study how model family, action encoding, memory design and post-training affect a video world model's reliability as a policy evaluator, then turns the findings into GigaWorld-1.

title: MV-Forcing: Long Multi-View Video Generation via 4D-Grounded Spatio-Temporal Self-Forcing
tldr_zh: 在单个扩散模型中组合时间与视角两种自回归，用自回归三维重建模型累积所有已生成视角的持久状态并渲染下一视角的几何先验，再以时空Self-Forcing蒸馏缓解曝光偏差。
tldr_en: Combines temporal and view-wise autoregression in one diffusion model, using an autoregressive 3D reconstruction model whose persistent state accumulates every generated view to render a geometric prior for the next viewpoint, and distills with spatio-temporal Self-Forcing to close the exposure-bias gap.

title: WAM-TTT: Steering World-Action Models by Watching Human Play at Test Time
tldr_zh: 测试时通过自监督视频预测把无标注人类视频吸收进冻结WAM内部的轻量自适应记忆，并用配对人机数据和键值记忆重建目标做元训练，使该记忆能引导机器人行为。
tldr_en: A test-time training framework that absorbs unlabeled human videos into a lightweight adaptive memory inside a frozen world action model via self-supervised video prediction, meta-trained on paired human-robot data with a key-value memory reconstruction objective so the memory can steer robot behavior.

title: PanoWorld: Real-World Panoramic Generation
tldr_zh: 针对全景世界模型的长程记忆，利用全景表示的旋转等变性把相机轨迹简化为固定朝向下的平移，以稠密全景射线条件建模当前动作、以几何感知记忆增强建模长程记忆，并构建无人机实拍与仿真结合的全景数据集World360。
tldr_en: Targets long-range memory in panoramic world models by exploiting rotation equivariance to reduce camera trajectories to translations under fixed headings, with dense panoramic ray conditioning for the current action and geometry-aware memory augmentation for long-range memory, plus World360, a dataset of drone-captured and simulated panoramic clips.

title: From Pixels to States: Rethinking Interactive World Models as Game Engines
tldr_zh: 以传统游戏引擎的动作、状态、观测循环为视角，从玩家动作控制、游戏状态动力学、状态与观测的持久性、实时交互生成等方面梳理交互式游戏世界模型，并搭建《黑神话：悟空》数据引擎，采集带帧对齐动作与真值状态的游戏录像。
tldr_en: Uses the action-state-observation loop of conventional game engines as a lens to review interactive game world models along player action control, game-state dynamics, state-observation persistence, and real-time generation, and builds a Black Myth: Wukong data engine that records gameplay with frame-aligned actions and ground-truth game states.

title: Self Gradient Forcing: Native Long Video Extrapolation
tldr_zh: 在Self Forcing中历史KV缓存只是冻结的展开状态，未来帧的损失无法监督早先latent如何写成键值；先无梯度地自展开记录上下文，再并行重算上下文KV与因果注意力，让未来损失训练模型写入更有用的因果记忆。
tldr_en: In Self Forcing the historical KV cache is frozen rollout state, so future losses never shape how earlier latents are written into keys and values; a gradient-free rollout first records the self-generated context, then the context KV and causal attention are recomputed in parallel so future losses train the memory writing.

title: WorldExam: Benchmarking World Models from Apparent Appearance to Inherent Reactivity
tldr_zh: 面向可控视频世界模型的分层诊断基准，涵盖画质、控制遵循、空间一致与世界反应四层，其中场景重访用往返相机运动检验模型对初始观测的空间记忆。
tldr_en: A hierarchical diagnostic benchmark for controllable video world models spanning visual quality, control adherence, spatial consistency and world reactivity, where a scene-revisit task uses round-trip camera motion to probe spatial memory of the initial view.

title: Long-Horizon Audio-Visual Generation for Persistent Stories and Interactive Worlds
tldr_zh: 统一音视频生成系统，长视频版用聚合多个前序镜头视觉证据与语音线索的跨镜头记忆保持角色外观和音色，世界模型版把导航输入转为度量六自由度相机轨迹注入，并在自生成展开上训练因果少步生成器。
tldr_en: A unified audio-visual generator whose long-video variant keeps character appearance and voice through cross-shot memory over prior shots and speech cues, while its world-model variant injects navigation inputs as metric 6-DoF camera trajectories, with a causal few-step generator trained on self-generated rollouts.

title: 4DGS-WAM: Bridging Past and Future with an Object-Centric World Action Model based on 4D Gaussian Splatting
tldr_zh: 以分离动态物体与静态背景的四维高斯作为持久场景表示，静态背景直接复用过去观测，策略模型预测参与者动作、世界模型预测其高斯变换，以物体为中心推演未来。
tldr_en: Keeps a persistent 4D Gaussian scene that separates dynamic objects from the static background, reusing previously observed background while a policy predicts actor actions and a world model predicts how their Gaussians transform.

title: GameWAM: A World Action Model for Video Games
tldr_zh: 面向原生游戏与GUI闭环控制的世界动作模型，并行生成未来画面与键鼠动作，按周期预测、执行、重规划，并把执行过的画面压缩进近期缓冲、淘汰时写入长期记忆槽位，形成跨周期持久历史。
tldr_en: A world action model for native gameplay and GUI control that jointly generates future frames and keyboard-mouse actions in predict-execute-replan cycles, compressing executed footage into a recent buffer whose evicted segments are written into long-term memory slots to keep history across cycles.

title: WALL-SS: Scaling Long-horizon World Models via Next-Scale Autoregression
tldr_zh: 以按尺度由粗到细的自回归生成观测与动作交错的机器人轨迹，用尺度压缩的长程记忆保留近期细节并压缩远期历史，配合自生成上下文训练和动作跟随与长期一致性奖励的在线对齐。
tldr_en: Generates interleaved robot observations and actions with coarse-to-fine next-scale autoregression, keeping recent steps at full resolution while compressing distant history, and adds training on self-generated context plus on-policy alignment with action-following and long-term consistency rewards.

title: DensityKV: Density-Guided KV Cache Compression for Long Video Generation
tldr_zh: 无需训练的历史KV库管理策略，为每个注意力头维护token级KV库，用post-RoPE键的Soft-Riesz密度度量冗余并限制邻域密度增长，使历史存储有界且不随推演长度增长。
tldr_en: A training-free policy for the historical KV bank of autoregressive video diffusion that keeps a token-level bank per attention head and uses Soft-Riesz density over post-RoPE keys to curb redundant accumulation, so storage stays bounded however long the rollout runs.

title: AlayaVista: Streaming World Modeling from Panoramic States to Perspective Video
tldr_zh: 把全景世界演化与透视观测合成解耦，先由单张图像扩展出360度场景先验，再以相机为条件分块自回归演化全景隐状态，由隐空间视口渲染器和细化器输出透视视频。
tldr_en: Decouples panoramic world evolution from perspective rendering: a single image is expanded into a 360-degree scene prior, a camera-conditioned panoramic latent state evolves chunk by chunk, and a latent viewport renderer plus refiner produces the perspective video.

title: World Models for Embodied Intelligence: From Plausible to Controllable to Actionable
tldr_zh: 按合理、可控、可行动逐级递进的能力层次组织具身世界模型，再以几何、物理、动作接地与数据、奖励、策略、模型自身改进回路交叉的矩阵，梳理操作、导航、运动、自动驾驶等领域的方法、数据集与评测，并讨论长时一致性等挑战。
tldr_en: Organizes embodied world models into plausible, controllable, and actionable capability levels, crosses geometry, physics, and action grounding with improvement loops over data, rewards, policies, and the model itself, and uses this to review manipulation, navigation, locomotion, and driving along with their datasets, benchmarks, and open problems such as long-horizon consistency.

title: PhysStream: Streaming Physics-Grounded Video Generation with Structured Scene Memory and Fine-Grained Motion Control
tldr_zh: 自回归物理图生视频模型，从已生成帧在线提取位置图与物体跟踪图作为结构化场景记忆，并以稀疏速度增量信号在生成中途控制多物体刚体运动。
tldr_en: An autoregressive physics-grounded image-to-video model that builds structured scene memory, positional and object-tracking maps, online from previously generated frames, and takes sparse velocity increments for mid-generation control of multi-object rigid-body motion.

title: Causal-History Test-Time Scaling for Failure Recovery in Autoregressive World-Action Models
tldr_zh: 针对自回归世界动作模型中执行错误进入因果历史并持续干扰预测的问题，无需训练地把故障恢复转化为对因果历史的测试时扩展：检测到持续无进展时触发恢复，截去不可靠的历史后缀、检索与当前物理状态匹配的历史锚点并由保留前缀重建KV状态，再比较完整历史、恢复前缀与完全重置三种假设推演出的未来，择优执行。
tldr_en: A training-free failure-recovery scheme for autoregressive world action models, where execution errors leak into the causal history: on persistent non-progress it cuts the unreliable history suffix, retrieves an anchor matching the current physical state to rebuild the KV state from the kept prefix, and picks among full-history, recovered-prefix and full-reset hypotheses by comparing the futures each one predicts.

title: ZYT-World: A Real-Time Controllable World Model for Closed-Loop Autonomous-Driving Simulation
tldr_zh: 面向闭环驾驶仿真的实时多视角世界模型，原生生成鱼眼与针孔混合相机组，经教师强制、因果一致性蒸馏与自展开分布匹配蒸馏得到单步流式生成器，并用真实采集的跨轨迹配对训练即插即用的隐式记忆模块，使重访同一地点时保持场景一致。
tldr_en: A real-time multi-view world model for closed-loop driving simulation that natively renders a mixed fisheye-pinhole rig, distills a bidirectional teacher into a one-step streaming generator, and adds a plug-in implicit memory module, trained on cross-trajectory pairs from real captures, to keep places consistent on revisit.

title: PileBelief: Persistent Physical State for Interaction-Driven World Modeling
tldr_zh: 针对部分可观测的挖掘场景，在观测条件物理先验之上加入按世界坐标寻址的形变记忆与物理响应记忆，以与动作对齐的读取和门控残差修正地形变化与结果预测；已完成的交互更新实测信念，假设动作则推进独立的想象状态。
tldr_en: For partially observed excavation, adds world-addressed deformation memory and physical-response memory on top of an observation-conditioned physical prior; action-aligned reads and gated residuals refine terrain-change and outcome predictions, with executed scoops updating the measured belief and hypothetical ones advancing a separate imagined state.

title: HappyWorld-Bench
tldr_zh: 按从生成构建到统一世界建模的六级能力框架，分视频、空间与具身世界模型三条赛道评测生成世界在探索、交互与修改下的可靠性，结合人类对比Elo与自动指标，考察长推演与重访中的一致性及多步动作下的状态保持。
tldr_en: A benchmark that grades world models on a six-level capability ladder across video, spatial and embodied tracks, pairing human A/B Elo with automatic metrics to test whether generated worlds stay consistent over long rollouts and revisits and keep state across multi-step actions.

title: GameDirector: Decoupling Gameplay Logic from Rendering for Player-Configurable Game World Models
tldr_zh: 把规则化的游戏逻辑与视觉渲染解耦：智能体导演根据玩家配置解读画面、更新显式游戏状态、控制NPC并执行规则，再把决策转成文本提示驱动视频世界模型渲染。
tldr_en: Decouples rule-based gameplay logic from rendering: an agentic director reads observations, updates explicit game state, controls NPCs and enforces player-configured rules, then turns its decisions into text prompts that drive a video world model.

title: DeltaWAM: Delta World Action Models for Bimanual Manipulation
tldr_zh: 双臂操作的世界动作模型，只预测视觉增量与动作，并用流式增量记忆以紧凑增量更新缓存的锚点上下文。
tldr_en: A world action model for bimanual manipulation that predicts visual deltas alongside actions, and keeps a streaming delta memory that updates cached anchor context with compact observed changes.

title: Shaping Persistent Representations from Independent Interactions
tldr_zh: 以交互之间的关系作弱监督塑造世界模型的持久上下文，让相关交互的上下文彼此一致（Align），并用一条交互的上下文预测另一条的未来（Cross），使跨轨迹共享的系统属性组织为可复用的上下文。
tldr_en: Uses relations between interactions as weak supervision for a world model's persistent context, making contexts from related interactions agree and using one interaction's context to predict another's future, so that properties shared across trajectories become reusable context.

title: Scaling Video Generation for Reasoning: At What Cost?
tldr_zh: 构建二阶魔方基准，固定视角只看到三个面，要求视频模型预测一串指定转动后的画面以检验其能否推断被遮挡面的状态，并研究模型规模、计算量与符号状态监督的影响。
tldr_en: Builds a 2x2x2 Rubik's Cube benchmark in which a video model sees only three faces from a fixed view and must predict frames after a series of prescribed moves, testing whether it can infer the hidden faces, and studies how model size, compute and symbolic state supervision affect this.

title: RolloutFaith: Auditing Persistent Internal Interventions in Visual World Model
tldr_zh: 提出衡量世界模型内部干预在停止编辑后能否持续改进后续自主预测的框架，在Crafter、Cartpole、CoinRun上比较多种编辑器，并通过逐一恢复状态分量定位干预效果经由最新生成帧还是循环记忆传递。
tldr_en: A framework that measures whether internal edits to a world model keep improving its later autonomous predictions after editing stops, comparing fitted editors on Crafter, Cartpole and CoinRun and tracing whether the effect persists through the newest generated frame or the recurrent memory.

title: CogWAM: Aligning Semantic Cognition with World Action Modeling via Event-Driven Interfaces
tldr_zh: 在世界动作模型中维护持久的语义状态，记录已完成的任务事件与当前子任务，只在观测显示语义转换时更新，并以进度条件化的世界与动作查询分别提取信息用于未来预测和动作生成。
tldr_en: A world-action model that keeps a persistent semantic state of completed task events and the active subtask, updates it only at observed semantic transitions, and uses progress-conditioned world and action queries to pull task-relevant context for future prediction and action generation.

title: JEPA-TTT: Persistent Test-Time Training of Latent World Models for Planning under Dynamics Shifts
tldr_zh: 在测试时持续更新预训练动作条件JEPA世界模型的隐空间动力学预测器，更新跨回合累积而编码器与奖励头保持冻结，并从按每个时间偏移构造预测窗口的稠密回放缓冲区采样训练，以在动力学变化下规划。
tldr_en: Keeps updating the latent dynamics predictor of a pretrained action-conditioned JEPA world model at test time, with updates accumulating across episodes while the encoder and reward head stay frozen, sampling from a growing dense-replay buffer of prediction windows to plan under shifted dynamics.

title: FutureWorlds: Learning Robotic World Models from Alternative Futures
tldr_zh: 基于多模态离散自回归模型的机器人世界模型，在强化学习中用多样束搜索构造候选未来，为每个候选维护有界记忆以保存场景状态，并以记忆条件化的组相对优势（MemSPO）优化世界模型。
tldr_en: A robotic world model on a multimodal discrete autoregressive backbone that builds candidate futures with diverse beam search during RL, gives each candidate its own bounded memory of scene states, and optimizes the model with memory-conditioned group-relative advantages (MemSPO).

title: LoGo: Local-Global Rewards for Consistent Long-Horizon Video Generation
tldr_zh: 为相机控制视频模型的后训练结合全局奖励与空间局部奖励，局部奖励细粒度分配信用以减少相机移动中的物体位移与场景结构变化，全局奖励维持相机跟随与画质，并提出长程复杂相机控制基准TrajectoryBench。
tldr_en: Post-trains camera-controlled video models with a blend of global and spatially localized rewards, where local rewards give fine-grained credit to curb object shifts and scene changes as the camera moves and the global reward preserves camera following and quality; also introduces TrajectoryBench for long, complex camera paths.

title: Considering Context: When World Models Need Context Encoders
tldr_zh: 提出预测充分性，衡量在智能体自身访问分布下环境隐上下文对下一步预测的增益，并将其分解为可从历史恢复的部分、需要真实上下文的残差与有限模型带来的缺口，用以判断世界模型何时需要上下文编码器。
tldr_en: Introduces predictive sufficiency, which measures what the latent environment context adds to next-step prediction under the agent's own visitation distribution and splits it into a history-recoverable part, a residual needing the true context, and a finite-model deficit, to judge when world models need context encoders.

title: Artemis: Geometry-Grounded Multi-Agent Driving World Models with Shared 3D State and Progressive Memory Update
tldr_zh: 多智能体驾驶世界模型，从多智能体观测重建显式三维世界地图作为共享状态，按动作渲染前景与背景控制图经GeoAdapter注入扩散Transformer，并用推演中选出的关键帧渐进更新地图。
tldr_en: A multi-agent driving world model that reconstructs an explicit 3D world map from all agents' observations as shared state, renders action-guided foreground and background control maps injected through a GeoAdapter into a diffusion transformer, and progressively updates the map with keyframes from the rollout.

title: Acting from Belief, Looking When Needed: A Bayesian Spatial World Model for Navigation under Intermittent Perception
tldr_zh: 用执行的动作传播结构化空间信念、借几何先验补全未观测结构，并在可靠性不足时才请求新观测，使无人机在感知间歇时仍能导航。
tldr_en: A Bayesian spatial world model propagates a structured spatial belief with executed actions, fills in unobserved structure from learned geometric priors, and requests a new depth image only when its predicted reliability is too low to navigate.

title: WorldCast: Distributed Multiplayer World Models
tldr_zh: 分布式多人世界模型，每个客户端由视频生成器和状态模型组成，交换玩家状态并投影成相机对齐的状态场来渲染其他玩家，同时把已生成画面存入共享场景记忆库，按对缺失像素的覆盖度检索与淘汰。
tldr_en: A distributed multiplayer world model in which each client pairs a video generator with a state model, exchanging player states that are projected into camera-aligned fields to render other players, and storing generated blocks in a shared scene memory bank that is retrieved and evicted by how well entries cover missing pixels.

title: WorldGuide: Goal-Directed Video World Model for Procedural Task Execution
tldr_zh: 把程序性视频生成做成闭环任务执行：规划器根据已生成画面选下一原子动作或终止，执行器生成对应片段，并用近细远粗的分层视觉记忆控制历史开销。
tldr_en: Frames procedural video generation as closed-loop task execution: a planner picks the next atomic action or stops based on generated progress, an executor renders the clip, and a hierarchical visual memory keeps recent frames fine and older ones coarse to bound history cost.

title: D-World: An Explicit World-Language-Action Model with Recursive Self-Improvement under Dual Control
tldr_zh: 感知智能体把场景写成可执行数字孪生，规划智能体在仿真中搜索动作，并在每个动作块执行后按测量修正孪生中的物体状态和物理参数。
tldr_en: A perception agent writes the scene as an executable digital twin, and a planning agent searches actions in simulation, revising the twin's object states and physical parameters against robot measurements after each action chunk.

title: Into the LidarVerse: A Real-Time Unified LiDAR World Model Across Tasks and Sensors
tldr_zh: 统一的LiDAR世界模型以目标传感器位姿、地图和历史为条件生成距离图序列，蒸馏为因果学生后同时维护滚动KV缓存和由自身生成累积的世界对齐空间缓存。
tldr_en: A unified LiDAR world model generates range sequences conditioned on target sensor poses, maps and history; its distilled causal student keeps both a rolling KV cache and a world-aligned spatial cache accumulated from its own generations.

title: Orbia: Do Generated Videos Form a Consistent 3D World?
tldr_zh: 构建交互式世界模型的三维一致性基准，通过受控探索与回访，从输入保持、已生成内容的持久性和三维自洽三个维度评测文本、动作与相机条件模型。
tldr_en: A benchmark for 3D consistency in interactive world models that uses controlled exploration and revisits to test input preservation, persistence of generated content, and 3D self-consistency across text-, action-, and camera-conditioned models.

title: RIGen: Beyond Action Following with Reciprocal Interaction in Generative Gameplay
tldr_zh: 在生成式游戏中维护持久的游戏状态与可配置规则，结合上下文交互推理与动作条件音视频生成，使玩家动作的后果和角色行为共同决定后续画面。
tldr_en: Maintains persistent game state and configurable rules alongside contextual interaction reasoning and action-conditioned audiovisual generation, so that the consequences of player actions and actor behavior jointly shape what is generated next.

title: IMPULSE: Push First, Then Predict in V-JEPA 2 Feature Space
tldr_zh: 先推几下物体，用贝叶斯接触记忆把推动结果汇总为少量可解释数值，经预测的物体位姿注入V-JEPA 2特征空间预测器，用于预测物体后续运动。
tldr_en: Pokes an object a few times first, summarizes the responses in a Bayesian contact memory of a few interpretable numbers, and feeds it through a predicted object pose into a V-JEPA 2 feature-space predictor to forecast how the object moves.

title: Matrix-Game 4.0: Harnessing Video Models for Real-Time Playable Game Worlds
tldr_zh: 由轻量游戏引擎维护世界状态并执行规则，自回归视频渲染器以引擎渲染的低模代理、动态描述和记忆参考为条件生成高保真画面，实现实时可玩的游戏世界。
tldr_en: Separates game execution from visual generation: a lightweight engine keeps world state and runs the rules, while an autoregressive video renderer turns engine-rendered low-poly proxies into detailed frames, conditioned on dynamic captions and memory references.

title: Slot-JEPA: Object-Structured Prediction Interfaces for Latent World Models
tldr_zh: 把JEPA的稠密表示分解为稳定的语义槽位与随时间变化的空间掩码，用转移记忆预测器以紧凑掩码存储视觉转移、按对应槽位统计检索上下文，并用非平衡最优传输监督掩码预测与评估规划。
tldr_en: Decomposes dense JEPA features into stable semantic slots and time-varying spatial masks, stores visual transitions as compact masks in a Transition Memory Predictor that retrieves context by corresponding-slot statistics, and uses unbalanced optimal transport to supervise mask prediction and score plans.

title: Plausible Future, Wrong Choice: Steering World-Action Models toward Intended Future
tldr_zh: 针对长程操作中世界动作模型生成走向错误阶段的阶段混淆，用模式令牌表示细粒度任务要求、用状态令牌闭环跟踪执行进度，组成结构化任务状态引导未来与动作生成，并构建多阶段操作基准StageBench。
tldr_en: Tackles stage confusion in long-horizon manipulation, where world action models drift toward the wrong task stage, by steering generation with a structured task state of Mode Tokens for task requirements and State Tokens that track execution progress in closed loop; also introduces the StageBench multi-stage benchmark.

title: UniWALM: Unified World Action Language Model for Embodied Robot Control
tldr_zh: 在同一混合Transformer中同步去噪视频、动作与语言，每步生成子任务与文本记忆并在下一步重新读入，形成以语言为记忆的闭环，并用带纠正的流匹配训练动作从扰动轨迹中恢复。
tldr_en: Co-denoises video, action, and language in one mixture-of-transformers backbone, generating subtasks and textual memory each step and feeding them back at the next to close a language-as-memory loop, with flow matching with correction teaching the action head to recover from perturbed trajectories.
